reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 13 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Timberwolves (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 82 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Sacramento (2-16) are being talked about as deadline sellers, with Domantas Sabonis, Zach LaVine and De'Andre Hunter the likeliest names, and LaVine (knee) has been out.
